status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The design implemented within the cycle's scope on the cycle's branch, and every item of the verification design verified as it says — or, where it cannot be, the reason recorded. The output names the commits the run made, as a range on the branch.

base.note: the branch the pull request is to merge into, the baseline of the lint chain's execution trust boundary (docs/submodule-common-rules.md > Verification and Tools); not given, the remote's default branch

previous_report.note: previous_report and findings are given on a re-run.

deferred.note: a JSON array of the recommendations deferred or separated after earlier evaluations, each {subject, finding, disposition}; the build leaves them to their disposition (the form is delivery.json's)

commits.note: {branch, from, to}: the branch the run worked on, its head when the run began (from) and its head when the run ended (to) — from equal to to when the run made no commit, the report saying why. The audit, quality and delivery modules take this file as their commits input.

green_blocker.note: Written when the design cannot be built as it stands: the decision that blocks and why. The design module takes it as an input on its re-run.

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/core.md > Development Lifecycle; ADR-0040 D1).
